# LLM Usage Log Analyzer

> Paste an LLM API usage log (JSONL, JSON or CSV) and see spend by model, feature and day, your cache hit rate, a 30-day run rate, and which levers -- caching, batch, a cheaper model -- would have saved money. Runs in your browser; the log never leaves it. Free, no signup.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
